প্রশ্ন প্রণয়নে:
জনাব সালেহ আহমেদ
৩৫তম বিসিএস (সাধারণ শিক্ষা)
প্রভাষক, ইংরেজি বিভাগ।
মৌলভীবাজার সরকারি কলেজ।

English Wizard.question: ১) Which sentence is the correct one?
English Wizard.option1: ক) If I had a virtuous friend, he will guide me to the right path.
English Wizard.option2: খ) If I had a virtuous friend, he would have guided me to the right path.
English Wizard.option3: গ) If I had a virtuous friend, he would guide me to the right path.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) If I had a virtuous friend, he would guided me to the right path.
English Wizard.exp:
If Clause- Past Indefinite Tense হলে, ২য় Clause হবে
Sub+ would+ Verb এর base form.

English Wizard.question: ২) Find out the correct sentence.
English Wizard.option1: ক) The man saved a lot of money lest he should not suffer in his old age.
English Wizard.option2: খ) The man saved a lot of money lest he would suffer in his old age.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The man saved a lot of money lest he should have suffered in his old age.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The man saved a lot of money lest he should suffer in his old age.
English Wizard.exp: Lest থাকলে তার পরের অংশে should/might + Verb এর base form বসবে। আর lest নিজেই negative হওয়ায় তার পরের অংশে not বসে না।

English Wizard.question: ৩) Which sentence is the correct one?
English Wizard.option1: ক) The man started eating as if he did never eat.
English Wizard.option2: খ) The man started eating as if he had never eaten.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The man started eating as if he never ate.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The man started eating as if he had never eat.
English Wizard.exp: as if এর আগের অংশ past indefinite হলে, এর পরের অংশ past perfect tense হয়।

English Wizard.question: ৪) Find out the correct sentence.
English Wizard.option1: ক) He hardly play golf.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Hardly had he played golf.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He played hardly golf.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He hardly plays golf.
English Wizard.exp:
hardly অর্থ কদাচিৎ বা না বললেই চলে। এটা থাকলে সাধারণত Present Indefinite বা Past Indefinite হয়। আর Adverb কখনো Object এর পূর্বে বসে না। এ হিসেবে গ ভুল এবং ঘ সঠিক।
আবার Hardly had ____ when অর্থ করতে না করতেই/ হতে না হতেই থাকলে Past Perfect+ Past Indefinite হয়। যেমন- Hardly had I reached the station when the train left.

English Wizard.question: ৫) Which one is the correct sentence?
English Wizard.option1: ক) Fuhad already had his lunch.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Fuhad has already his lunch.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Fuhad has already had his lunch.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Fuhad have already had his lunch.
English Wizard.exp: already থাকলে Present Perfect Tense হয়। Present Perfect হিসেবে Sub+ has+ already+ had (মূল Verb এর Past Participle) হবে।

English Wizard.question: ৬) Find out the correct sentence.
English Wizard.option1: ক) The ships were carrying a lot of sheeps.
English Wizard.option2: খ) The ship were carrying a lot of sheeps.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The ships were carrying a lot of sheep.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The sheeps were carrying a lot of ship.
English Wizard.exp:
ship= জাহাজ, এটার plural – ships
sheep = ভেড়া, এটার plural ও – sheep

English Wizard.question: ৭) Find out the incorrect sentence.
English Wizard.option1: ক) The majority were in his favour.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Cattle are grazing in the field.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The peasantry were utterly dissatisfied with the landlords.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The army has attacked the enemy.
English Wizard.exp:
majority, cattle, peasantry, army এগুলো সবসময় Plural হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়।
যেহেতু The Army - plural হিসাবে ব্যবহৃত হয়, তাই অপশন ঘ) তে 'has' ব্যবহার হওয়ায় বাক্যটি ভুল।

English Wizard.question: ৮) Which sentence is the correct one?
English Wizard.option1: ক) He is an university student.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Sorforaz Khan was an heir to the throne.
English Wizard.option3: গ) I saw an one-eyed man.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He was in an hostile situation.
English Wizard.exp:
খ ছাড়া সবকটিতে article ব্যবহারে ভুল হয়েছে।
Correct Sentences:
He is a university student.
I saw a one-eyed man.
He was in a hostile situation.

English Wizard.question: ৯) Find out the correct sentence.
English Wizard.option1: ক) A few water was left in the bottle.
English Wizard.option2: খ) A little oranges were bought by him.
English Wizard.option3: গ) An amount of money was allocated for the work.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) A great many students fails in English only because of their fear of English
English Wizard.exp:
A few + uncountable noun = not okay
A little + countable plural noun = not okay
An amount of + money → okay
A great many + Plural noun+ singular verb = not okay, plural verb হলে সঠিক হত।

English Wizard.question: ১০) Which sentence has no error?
English Wizard.option1: ক) He left hostel with all his belongings.
English Wizard.option2: খ) I prefer vegetable to meat.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Circumstance has led him to act against his countrymen.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He has spent all his saving.
English Wizard.exp: belongings, vegetables, circumstances, savings- এগুলো সব সময় Plural Form এ ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং এগুলোর পরের Verb ও Plural হয়।

English Wizard.question: ১১) Which one is the correct sentence?
English Wizard.option1: ক) Mr. Smith was a monk.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Elizabeth was the then prince of England.
English Wizard.option3: গ) She was the master of the house.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Joshim was a fovourite actress.
English Wizard.exp:
ক ছাড়া সবগুলোকে Gender ব্যবহারে ভুল হয়েছে।
সঠিক বাক্য হবে:
Elizabeth was the then princess of England.
She was the mistress of the house.
Joshim was a fovourite actor.

English Wizard.question: ১২) Which one is the correct one?
English Wizard.option1: ক) He got used to tell lies at his boyhood.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He got used to telling lies at his boyhood.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He got used telling lies at his boyhood.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He got used to be telling lies at his boyhood.
English Wizard.exp: to এর পর verb এর base form হলেও with a view to, look forward to, be used to, get used to (অভ্যস্থ হওয়া) ইত্যাদি এর পর verb+ ing হয়।

English Wizard.question: ১৩) Find out the correct sentence.
English Wizard.option1: ক) That the poor are born to suffer seems their inevitable destiny.
English Wizard.option2: খ) That the poor are born to suffer seem their inevitable destiny.
English Wizard.option3: গ) That the poor are born to suffer is seemed their inevitable destiny.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) That the poor are born to suffer seeming their inevitable destiny.
English Wizard.exp:
এখানে seem Verb এর Subject হচ্ছে That the poor are born to suffer পুরোটা। Clause – Subject হলে সেটাকে Singular ধরতে হয়। কারণ পুরোটা দিয়ে একটা Idea বুঝাচ্ছে।
অতএব, Clause- Subject হলে এটাকে মনে মনে It ধরে নিবেন, তাহলে সহজে সঠিক Verb বসাতে পারবেন। যেমন- এখানে it seems their inevitable destiny. তাই সঠিক উত্তর ক।

English Wizard.question: ১৪) Which one is the correct sentence?
English Wizard.option1: ক) Bodrul accompanied by his friends have played a prominent role in the matter.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Bodrul accompanying by his friends has played a prominent role in the matter.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Bodrul accompanied by his friends has played a prominent role in the matter.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Bodrul accompanied by his friends have been played a prominent role in the matter.
English Wizard.exp: accompanied by এর আগের অংশের noun/pronoun অনুযায়ী verb বসবে। এ হিসেবে has played হবে।

English Wizard.question: ১৫) He saw her when he was at four. Here ‘when he was at four’ is –
English Wizard.option1: ক) Adjective clause
English Wizard.option2: খ) Noun clause
English Wizard.option3: গ) Adverbial clause
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Principal clause
English Wizard.exp:
when he was at four Verb সংঘটিত হওয়ার সময় প্রকাশ করছে। এজন্য এটি adverbial clause.
at four = at the age of four.

English Wizard.question: ১৬) I don’t understand how a man can become so cruel. Here, ‘how a man can become so cruel’ is a/an -
English Wizard.option1: ক) Adverbial clause
English Wizard.option2: খ) Adjective clause
English Wizard.option3: গ) Compound clause
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Noun clause
English Wizard.exp:
how a man can become so cruel, understand- verb এর object হিসাবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।
transitive verb এর object হিসাবে noun clause ব্যবহৃত হয়।
টেকনিক: যদি Clause টির পরিবর্তে it বসিয়ে বাক্য পরিপূর্ণ sense create করে, তবে সেটা noun clause হবে. যেমন-
I don’t understand it.

English Wizard.question: ১৭) The man <u>I am watching on</u> may be a thief. The underlined phrase is -
English Wizard.option1: ক) Adjective clause
English Wizard.option2: খ) Adverb clause
English Wizard.option3: গ) Noun clause
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Co-ordinate clause
English Wizard.exp: Man - Noun কে Modify করার কারণে Adjective clause.

English Wizard.question: ১৮) It is good for health <u>that you walk in the morning</u>. Here, the underlined clause is -
English Wizard.option1: ক) Adverbial clause
English Wizard.option2: খ) Participle clause
English Wizard.option3: গ) Noun clause
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Adjective clause
English Wizard.exp:
complement হওয়ার কারণে Noun Clause.
complement হচ্ছে “কী” প্রশ্নের এমন উত্তর যা Subject বা Object নয়, তবে Subject বা Object এর জায়গায় replaceable.

English Wizard.question: ১৯) He <u>who is of huge wealth</u> does not always lead a happy life. What type of clause is the underlined one?
English Wizard.option1: ক) Noun clause
English Wizard.option2: খ) Adjective clause
English Wizard.option3: গ) Adverb clause
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Principal clause
English Wizard.exp: He- pronoun কে Modify করার কারণে Adjective clause.

English Wizard.question: ২০) He decided <u>that he would stop communicating with us</u>. What type of clause is the underlined one?
English Wizard.option1: ক) Noun clause
English Wizard.option2: খ) Principal clause
English Wizard.option3: গ) Adverb clause
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Adjective clause
English Wizard.exp: decided– Verb এর Object হওয়ার কারণে Noun clause.

English Wizard.question: ২১) The poet wants to escape where peace is never disturbed. Here ‘where peace is never disturbed’ is –
English Wizard.option1: ক) Co-ordinate clause
English Wizard.option2: খ) Adverb clause
English Wizard.option3: গ) Noun clause
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Adjective clause
English Wizard.exp: Clause টি verb সংঘটিত হওয়ার স্থান বা adverb of place নির্দেশ করছে।

English Wizard.question: ২২) <u>As her sixth and last son died a premature death</u>, she reacted with a strange quietness. What type of Adverb Clause is the underlined one?
English Wizard.option1: ক) Adverb Clause of Condition
English Wizard.option2: খ) Adverb Clause of Time
English Wizard.option3: গ) Adverb Clause of Manner
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Adverb Clause of Cause
English Wizard.exp:
As এখানে when/while (যখন) অর্থে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে। যখন তার ষষ্ঠ ও শেষ পুত্রের অকালমৃত্যু ঘটেছে তখনই সে এক অদ্ভুত নীরবতার সাথে প্রতিক্রিয়া জানাল।
এখানে As অর্থ because/since (যেহেতু/কারণ) বেমানান।
তাই underlined clause-টি Adverb Clause of Time.

English Wizard.question: ২৩) Only he will survive in the business world <u>who can cope with the everchanging market</u>. What type of clause is the underlined one?
English Wizard.option1: ক) Noun Clause
English Wizard.option2: খ) Adjective Clause
English Wizard.option3: গ) Adverb Clause
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Co-ordinate Clause
English Wizard.exp: He – Pronoun কে modify করার কারণে Adjective Clause হয়েছে।

English Wizard.question: ২৪) As you sow, so you reap. What type of clause is “so you reap”?
English Wizard.option1: ক) Noun Clause
English Wizard.option2: খ) Adjective Clause
English Wizard.option3: গ) Adverb Clause
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Principal Clause
English Wizard.exp:
As you sow – Adverb Clause
So you reap – principal clause
so এখানে Demonstrative pronoun.

English Wizard.question: ২৫) I am not satisfied that you have got ‘A’ in the exam. What type of clause is “that you have got ‘A’ in the exam”?
English Wizard.option1: ক) Adjective clause
English Wizard.option2: খ) Adverbial clause
English Wizard.option3: গ) Noun clause
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Principal clause
English Wizard.exp:
এটাতে Confusion লেগে যেতে পারে, কারণ এটা মনে হতে পারে Adjective (satisfied) কে Modify করছে, বিধায় Adverbial Clause.
কিন্তু ‘that you have got ‘A’ in the exam’ এখানে মূলত একটি উহ্য Preposition (with অর্থাৎ satisfied with) এর Object. এ হিসেবে এটি Noun Clause.
